subject: Magic Floors

evidence.quote: |MAGIC FLOORS | NONE           | NONE       | YES          |20+HP-STEP|

subject: Poison Swamp
text: Traversing Poison Swamp causes 2 or more damage per step with high encounter rates.

evidence.quote: |POISON SWAMP | HIGH           | MOD-STRONG | YES          |2+HP-STEP |

subject: King
text: You must speak with the King to save at any point during your quest.

evidence.quote: Also realize that to save at any point during your quest, you must go back to the King and talk to him to save.

subject: Fight command
text: Choosing the Fight command attacks the enemy with your equipped weapon and can result in critical damage or a complete miss.

evidence.quote: *Fight - Choose this option, the main option you'll use in all fights, to attack your enemy with whatever weapon you have equipped. Do keep in mind that sometimes when you attack you'll do critical damage (or above average damage) to your target, and othertimes you'll miss completely.

subject: Run command
text: Selecting Run allows an attempt to escape battle, though enemies may also flee when overpowered.

evidence.quote: *Run - Choose this option if you feel you're over-powered in a fight, you think you're gonna perish, or if you just don't feel like fighting....(keep in mind that enemies can flee from battle as well, and often use their own run command when THEY themselves feel over-powered in battle).

subject: Spell command
text: Using spells requires sufficient character level and consumes Magic Points (MP).

evidence.quote: *Spell - Once high enough in level, your character will start being able to utilize spells, both offensive and defensive spells, from healing spells for your character to offensive attack spells to use on your enemy....Each spell uses a certain amount of Magic Points (MP), so be weary of this.

subject: Item command
text: The Item command allows using an item such as a healing herb during combat, though most items cannot be used in battle.

evidence.quote: *Item - Finally, the item command allows you to chose an item to use in battle, which is almost always some sort of healing herb. Most items can't be used actively in battle, so be aware of that when choosing certain items, otherwise you'll be hindered.

subject: Leveling
text: Crossing bridges or entering new areas exposes you to much stronger monsters, making frequent leveling essential.

evidence.quote: From one area to another the enemies get much stronger, so you can be kicking the garbage out of enemies in one area, cross a bridge, and get utterly destroyed in the next area by the next area's monsters.

subject: Death
text: Dying causes you to lose half of your held gold pieces.

evidence.quote: It's VITAL, because if you die, you'll lose half of your gold pieces you had at time of death.

subject: Tantagel Castle
text: The recommended level for starting in Tantagel Castle is level 1.

evidence.quote: SUGGESTED LEVEL – Since you won't be fighting at all, level 1.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: Opening the treasure chests in the throne room yields 120 gold.

evidence.quote: Open the three treasure chests around the throne room to get 120 gold, a Torch, and a Magic Key.

subject: Treasure Chest

evidence.quote: Open the three treasure chests around the throne room to get 120 gold, a Torch, and a Magic Key.

subject: Throne Room Door
text: Using the Door command with the Magic Key permanently unlocks the throne room door.

evidence.quote: Go up to the door and use the Door command, and the key will be used, but that door will be always open for now on.

subject: Throne Room Door
text: Passing through the unlocked throne room door leads to stairs taking you outside into Tantagel Castle.

evidence.quote: Once through the door, go down the stairs....Here you'll be outside, in the castle of Tantagel.

subject: King Lorik
text: King Lorik records your deeds in his Imperial Scroll to save your game.

evidence.quote: Speak to them, and they'll say, "King Lorik will record thy deeds in his Imperial Scroll so thou may return to thy quest later."

subject: Guard
text: A guard inside Tantagel Castle advises taking a torch when entering caves.

evidence.quote: Talk to the first mobile guard you come to and he'll say, "When entering the cave, take with thee a torch."

subject: Tantagel Castle
text: Exiting Tantagel Castle to the world map and traveling directly east brings you to the town of Brecconary.

evidence.quote: As you find yourself for the first time on the world map, you'll see a town directly to your right. Go –right- to the castle, you don't have any weapons or armor equipped, even the simplest enemy like a slime will give you trouble right now. Go right to the town. This is the town of Brecconary.

subject: Garniham
text: A townsfolk in Brecconary mentions that Garniham is reached by going north to the seashore and following the coastline west.

evidence.quote: Talk to the wandering person around the center of the town, and he'll tell you to, "Go north to the seashore, then follow the coastline west until thou hath reached Garniham."

subject: Charlock
text: A man in Brecconary states that Charlock, the fortress of the Dragonlord, lies within sight to the south of Tantagel Castle.

evidence.quote: Talk to the wandering man near the building, and he'll say, "Within sight of Tantagel Castle to the south is Charlock, the fortress of the Dragonlord."

subject: Equipment
text: Run around outside of a new town to get enough money so characters have the optimum equipment at the soonest possible time.

evidence.quote: If you come across a new town with new gear for your characters, run around outside of town and get enough money making sure your characters all have the optimum equipment at the soonest possible time.
